# Turndown GFM Plugin

- Package: `turndown-plugin-gfm@1.0.2`
- Source: https://github.com/mixmark-io/turndown-plugin-gfm
- License: MIT
- Vendored file: `turndown-plugin-gfm.js`

These browser runtimes provide the conversion engine and default GFM rules for
the `turndownToMarkdown` flow node. Page-specific behavior remains in the
flow's declarative `customRules` configuration.
